question: Plants conduct sugars and other substances throughout their body by means of phloem. Phloem is a compound tissue, including different cell types (e.g. sieve-tubes elements (in angiosperms), companion cells and parenchymal cells.). In a study, DNA genomic samples prepared from sieve-tubes and companion cells of an angiosperm and investigated for DNA corresponding to X. Gene-specific primers were used to amplify gene X among whole genome of cells by PCR. Sieve-tube Companion Ladder element cell ee ee Pa!
